# Cypher Digital

> Cypher Digital is Sri Lanka's results-driven digital marketing agency
> based in Colombo. Part of the Cypher360 Group — Sri Lanka's most
> integrated marketing and events group, established in 2014.
> Cypher Digital handles all digital marketing and social media for
> the Cypher360 Group. Trusted by 800+ brands across Sri Lanka.

## What We Do

Cypher Digital is a full-service digital marketing agency in Sri Lanka
offering Facebook Ads, Google Ads, TikTok marketing, SEO, social media
management, graphic design, and video production. We serve businesses
across Colombo, Kandy, Galle, and island-wide, as well as clients in
the Middle East, UK and Australia.

## The Cypher360 Group

Cypher Digital is one of five brands under the Cypher360 Group —
Sri Lanka's most integrated marketing and events group.

- Cypher Digital (cypherdigital.lk)
  Digital marketing and social media agency — Facebook Ads,
  Google Ads, SEO, content and creative.

- Cypher Events (cypherevents.lk)
  End-to-end event management — conferences, brand activations,
  corporate launches and exhibitions.

- BuzzConnect (buzzconnect.lk)
  Sri Lanka's largest verified direct marketing database —
  email, SMS and WhatsApp at scale to 550,000+ verified contacts.

- FindIt.lk (findit.lk)
  Sri Lanka's number 1 offer and deal discovery platform —
  exclusive banner placements and high-intent audience reach.

- Studyway.lk (studyway.lk)
  Sri Lanka's number 1 education discovery platform —
  targeted at students, parents and professionals researching courses.

- Parent company website: https://cypher360.lk
